title: Lens attachment error
shortDescription: X-mount body does not see the attached lens.
fullDescription:
Fujifilm X and GFX bodies show 'Lens not recognized' or 'Check lens attachment' when communication with the lens fails. Typical causes are a misaligned lens, dirty contacts, or outdated firmware on Fringer / third-party adapters.

Reseating clears most cases. Persistent failures require firmware update or contact cleaning.

fixSteps.title: Reseat lens
fixSteps.instruction: Align the white index, rotate to the click.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Use a dry microfiber on the gold pins.

fixSteps.title: Update lens firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Copy the .DAT file to an SD card and update via Menu.

whenToCallPro: If contacts or mount pins are visibly damaged.

faq.a: Yes, Fringer releases firmware to support new Fuji bodies regularly.

title: Memory card unreadable
shortDescription: File system corrupted or card incompatible.
fullDescription:
Fuji bodies show 'Card not initialized' when the SD or CFexpress card's file system cannot be read. Formatting in-camera fixes most cases; failing cards require replacement.

Always back up before formatting.

fixSteps.title: Back up card via reader
fixSteps.instruction: Copy recoverable data to computer first.

whenToCallPro: If multiple known-good cards fail — service slot.

faq.a: Yes, tools like PhotoRec often recover before formatting.

displayCode: Turn off camera and turn on again
title: Thermal or firmware hiccup shutdown
shortDescription: Camera asks user to cycle power after an internal fault.
fullDescription: This message follows overheating, a firmware glitch, or a shock event. Power-cycle clears transient faults; repeated occurrence indicates hardware or firmware issue needing update or service.

fixSteps.title: Remove battery 60 seconds
fixSteps.instruction: Full power disconnect clears RAM state.

whenToCallPro: If the error returns immediately after every power-on.
videoSearchQuery: Fujifilm turn off camera and turn on fix

faq.a: Yes, a corrupt card can crash the firmware.

title: Custom recipe / film simulation corruption
shortDescription: Recipe settings revert or won't save.
fullDescription: After firmware updates, custom film simulation recipes can become corrupted — settings fail to persist across power cycles or revert to default. Resetting the custom register and re-entering values fixes this.

fixSteps.title: Reset custom settings
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > User Setting > Reset > Shooting Menu Reset.

fixSteps.title: Re-save each recipe
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust parameters and save to C1-C7.

videoSearchQuery: Fujifilm film simulation recipe not saving fix

faq.a: Fujifilm X App allows backup/sync on recent bodies.

title: Autofocus motor or driver failure
shortDescription: Lens cannot complete an AF cycle.
fullDescription:
Shown when the AF drive hunts indefinitely or returns an error. Causes: dirty contacts, stuck linear motor in lens, or AF-C subject-tracking misconfiguration.

Switch to MF to confirm lens mechanically fine; then clean/reseat/update firmware.

fixSteps.title: Switch to MF and check
fixSteps.instruction: If MF works lens mechanics fine; issue is communication.

whenToCallPro: If MF also fails or lens rattles.

faq.a: Yes — using 'Set 4' on a static subject causes hunt.

title: Mechanical shutter fault
shortDescription: Shutter curtain did not complete its cycle.
fullDescription: Fuji X-series use a focal-plane shutter rated 200K-300K actuations. Beyond life or after shock, blades can stick. Using electronic shutter can keep the camera usable until service.

fixSteps.title: Send for shutter replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Fujifilm service center replaces the shutter assembly.

faq.q: How do I see shutter count?
faq.a: ExifTool shows ImageCount tag on Fuji raw files.

title: In-body image stabilizer fault
fullDescription: Fuji X-H and X-T4/T5 bodies self-test IBIS at startup. A failure shows an error and disables IS. Often transient after a drop; persistent issue requires IBIS service.
whenToCallPro: If sensor visibly tilted or rattles.

faq.a: Yes, disable IS in menu and use OIS lenses or tripod.

title: NP-W235/NP-W126S false low warning
shortDescription: Battery reads empty in cold weather despite charge.
fullDescription: Li-ion cells drop voltage in cold. The body interprets the sag as empty. Warming the battery often restores charge reading. In long-term use, degraded cells amplify this.

fixSteps.title: Warm battery
fixSteps.instruction: Place in inner pocket for 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Replace if aged
fixSteps.instruction: If >500 cycles, buy a genuine NP-W235/NP-W126S.

faq.a: Usually yes, but capacity gauge can be off.

title: SD lock switch engaged
fullDescription: Shown when SD card LOCK slider is toward the bottom. Slide it up to enable writing.
affectedModels: All Fujifilm bodies with SD slot

title: Temperature shutdown
shortDescription: Camera halts video to protect internals.
fullDescription: Fuji X-H2S, X-T5, GFX 100 II can hit thermal limits during long 6K/8K or 4K 120p takes. A warning icon precedes shutdown. The optional FAN-001 accessory or Auto Power Off Temp set to High extends recording.

fixSteps.title: Set Auto Power Off Temp High
Attach FAN-001
fixSteps.instruction: Optional cooling fan accessory on compatible bodies.

whenToCallPro: Only if overheating at idle in normal temps.

faq.a: Yes, roughly doubles continuous record time on X-H2S.
